meta.name: check-prereqs
meta.description: Survey the machine and report which nyann features are usable right now. TRIGGER when the user says "is my machine ready for nyann", "what do I need to install", "check my setup", "do I have the right tools", "check prereqs", "audit my environment", "new machine, what's missing", "I'm on a new machine", "install nyann prereqs", "/nyann:check-prereqs". Do NOT trigger on general "what is nyann" questions — those want a docs pointer, not a machine survey. Do NOT trigger when the user is already mid-bootstrap — let the bootstrap-project skill handle that case and emit its own skip records for missing stack tools.
